prompt: Bug report: parseCSV(text) in src/csv.js breaks on quoted fields. It must follow RFC 4180. Fields may be wrapped in double quotes. A quoted field may contain commas, line breaks, and doubled double quotes ("") that stand for one literal quote; the surrounding quotes are not part of the value. Lines end with \n or \r\n. A final line ending does not create an extra row, and empty input returns []. Empty fields are empty strings. Return an array of rows, each an array of strings. Fix it.
